summary: Frontend-only verification of Products/Services revamp (10 services, no Vehicle Branding), product detail gallery, Market Areas page, header nav dropdown, gallery slug integrity, RFQ product dropdown, and mobile responsiveness. All acceptance criteria PASSED on the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
critical_code_review_comments: Header dropdown lists all 10 services — fine, but on shorter viewports (xl breakpoint) navigation is hidden behind mobile menu; consider medium-breakpoint compact nav if desired (non-blocking).

ProductGallery relies on remote Unsplash/Pexels URLs — all currently return 200 but they are third-party CDN dependencies; consider caching/self-hosting key hero images for reliability (non-blocking).
QuoteForm uses a native <select> for product — works but no data-testid on the select element; suggest adding data-testid="quote-product-select" for future automation (minor).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Detailed verification done: /products shows exactly 10 cards (all correct slugs incl. engraving-services), NO Vehicle Branding/Graphics text on home or products, header has nav-market-areas link, products dropdown lists all 10 slugs (no vehicle), Gallery page links only to valid new slugs, /market-areas has 4 regions with 51 chips and 4 /contact CTAs, /products/asset-tags gallery main image + 4 thumbs work, thumbnail click and prev/next both swap main image, detail-quote-btn -> /contact, detail-whatsapp-btn -> wa.me/971561159894, detail-call-btn -> tel:+971561159894, all 10 detail pages load with 3-4 gallery images each and every image URL returns HTTP 200 (0 broken), RFQ /contact product <select> lists all 10 new services + 'Other/General Enquiry'. Mobile 390px: no horizontal overflow on /products, /products/asset-tags, /market-areas.
